summary: CICS online Card Detail (view) screen. The user enters an account number and/or card number; the program validates them and reads the matching card record to display its details. Read-only inquiry. Can look up a card either by account+card key or by account alone. Pseudo-conversational via a 2000-byte COMMAREA.

paragraphs.name: 0000-MAIN
paragraphs.pseudocode: Pseudo-conversational entry. On first entry send the card-detail screen. On re-entry evaluate the key: PF3 return to menu; Enter validate the account/card inputs and read+display the card; other keys re-display with an error. Return to CICS with the COMMAREA.

paragraphs.name: COMMON-RETURN
paragraphs.pseudocode: Save state and CICS RETURN with the transaction id.

paragraphs.name: 1000-SEND-MAP
paragraphs.pseudocode: Build and send the card-detail map (init, set variables, set attributes, transmit).

paragraphs.name: 1200-SETUP-SCREEN-VARS
paragraphs.pseudocode: Move the card record fields into the display fields.

paragraphs.name: 1300-SETUP-SCREEN-ATTRS
paragraphs.pseudocode: Set field attributes and cursor (highlight errors).

paragraphs.name: 1400-SEND-SCREEN
paragraphs.pseudocode: Transmit the card-detail map to the terminal.

paragraphs.name: 2000-PROCESS-INPUTS
paragraphs.pseudocode: Receive the map and validate the account/card inputs.

paragraphs.name: 2100-RECEIVE-MAP
paragraphs.pseudocode: Receive the card-detail map from the terminal.

paragraphs.name: 2200-EDIT-MAP-INPUTS
paragraphs.pseudocode: Validate the account and card inputs.

paragraphs.name: 2210-EDIT-ACCOUNT
paragraphs.pseudocode: Validate the account number is present, numeric and a valid 11-digit account id.

annotations.note: BUSINESS RULE: account number must be present, numeric and 11 digits.

paragraphs.name: 2220-EDIT-CARD
paragraphs.pseudocode: Validate the card number, if entered, is numeric and 16 digits.

annotations.note: BUSINESS RULE: card number must be a valid 16-digit number.

paragraphs.name: 9000-READ-DATA
paragraphs.pseudocode: Read the card record: if both account and card were supplied read by account+card key, otherwise read by account alone.
branches: IF card supplied -> by acct+card ELSE by acct

paragraphs.name: 9100-GETCARD-BYACCTCARD
paragraphs.pseudocode: Read the card record by the account+card composite key (CICS READ); on not-found set an error.

paragraphs.name: 9150-GETCARD-BYACCT
paragraphs.pseudocode: Read the card record by account id alone (CICS READ / browse first match); on not-found set an error.

paragraphs.name: SEND-LONG-TEXT
paragraphs.pseudocode: Send a longer plain-text message to the terminal.

paragraphs.name: SEND-PLAIN-TEXT
paragraphs.pseudocode: Send a short plain-text message to the terminal.

paragraphs.name: ABEND-ROUTINE
paragraphs.pseudocode: On unrecoverable error, display an abend message and terminate the transaction.
